name: What types of roofs are suitable for sun-exposure protective painting?

mainEntity.name: What types of roofs are suitable for sun-exposure protective painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sun-exposure protective paints are typically suitable for a variety of low-slope and flat roof types, including modified bitumen, EPDM, TPO, metal, and some asphalt-based systems. The suitability largely depends on the specific coating product and the condition of the existing roof substrate. A professional roof inspection will determine if your roof material and its current state are compatible with a protective coating application and what surface preparation is required.
acceptedAnswer.description: They are suitable for many low-slope and flat roofs like modified bitumen, EPDM, and metal; compatibility depends on the specific coating and roof condition.
